title: The Weekly Challenge - 400
task1_desc: You are given a positive integer. Write a script that generates a sequence of integers from 1 to given positive integer, filtering out any numbers that contain repeating digits (e.g., 11, 99, 100, and 101 are excluded) and return the biggest jump.
task2_desc: You are given start and end gene string along with gene bank. Write a script to return the minimum number of mutations required to mutate from start to end gene. Return -1 if there is no such mutation. A gene must be in a bank to make it a valid gene string.
